use_when.text: Set a useful default size so users can see that they can enter multiple lines.
Use a text area when the response may naturally span more than one line; use a text field for short values.
Use comfortable line-height inside the textarea so multi-line content stays readable

dont_use_when.text: Don’t make the initial field too small for the expected response.
Don’t use a text area for short, single-line information such as a name, email address, or postal code. Use TextField.
Don’t truncate or silently discard text when users reach a limit.
Don’t make the field so short that users can’t review a typical response.
Don’t use a text area for sensitive information that needs protected password-style entry.

a11y.text: The label is a native <label> tied to the textarea’s id.
Renders a native <textarea>; state="disable" sets disabled.
